posts.author: SmashArtist
posts.body:
Welcome to...
Open to make almost any art you need for your game! I'm here because I love helping projects grow!
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
- ANNOUNCEMENT -
Because the forum is closing,
I'm opening up as requests to as many people as I can
. I'm ignoring slots, though I do ask that you
keep your request to one item per person
. I cannot promise when these will be done, so please
let me know where I can reach you after the forum closes
. I mainly have a discord and an email.
Although I'm doing my best to back up the assets, I cannot promise what you've requested in the past to be safe, so please make your own backups of any of the assets you requested!
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
Requests:
@Juanita
@Silver_Crusader
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RULES/TERMS
I'm available to make art as long as you follow the rules/terms listed below! Make sure to read them carefully!
By using/requesting my resources you agree to follow the rules/terms below
.
​
Spoiler:
SA's Workshop RULES/TERMS
When requesting from me, you agree to follow these rules and terms:
BEFORE REQUESTING
(General things to take note of):
​
Wait until there is an open seat to send me a request.
Only one person per seat.
If you make a request here, please
do not
also request for it somewhere else.
All completed art pieces will be in PNG format.
I can make resources for the XP, VX Ace, MV and MZ engines.
It is up to you to format and name resources so they work with your project.
I will
not
show you the progress of your request.
Some requests will take me longer to complete than others, and it is possible that I will be unable to finish a request.
(please look at the difficulty levels of each resource type and style for an approximation of how long it will take me to complete)
I have the right to refuse any requests at my own discretion!
Any request you make will be available to the public, so do not request anything that you wouldn't want others to use.
I WILL NOT...
​
...make anything with explicit mature content.
(Such as intense gore or partial to full nudity, I'm okay with some blood)
...make anything that involves real-world people or politics.
...make anything that is copyrighted material.
(Such as characters that do not belong to you, and/or art for fan games)
...make edits or art of other people's work unless they give you permission to have me do so.
...reformat any tiles or art for you.
WHEN REQUESTING:
Make sure to follow the
request format
when requesting!
(included at the bottom of this post)
Only ask for
one
resource at a time.
Please
do not
ask for a resource if it already exists.
(Make sure to do a search for what you're looking for before making a request.)
Do not
send me your requests through PM. Reply to this thread for your request.
You must own a copy of the engine you are asking resources for.
TERMS OF USE
(For completed resources):
​
-- Credit required! --
Credit
SmashArtist
in your game's credits if you use any of the resources made in this workshop.
-- Available for both non-commercial and commercial games! --
Send me a free copy of your game!
(I would love to check it out!)
Please notify me that you're using my assets!
(When your game releases)
-- RTP Edits! --
If the resource you want to use is an edit from an RPG Maker Engine, please follow the terms for those resources as well.
-- Edits? --
Yes! Feel free to edit any of these artworks to your liking.
However,
edits cannot be distributed.
(unless in the context of being in your game)
Exception:
You may share any edits of the resources provided on this post here for others to use.
Any edits of my assets
will be under the same terms of use
, except you will be added to the list of people to be credited.
-- Re-post? --
No. Please don't re-post any of my art.
-- I DO NOT allow use for... --
...projects with an 18+ rating.
(excessive gore/sexual themes)
...projects with politics.
...NFTs or generative AI.
...any projects I personally am not comfortable with at my discretion.
By using/requesting my resources you agree to follow the rules/terms above
.
If you have any further questions or details you need to add to your request, feel free to PM me.​
RESOURCE TYPES and STYLES
The type of art you can request and examples!​
Spoiler:
SA's Workshop TYPES and STYLES
NOTE 1 : There may be a lack in examples, but my plan is to build up the collection! Warning: Some of the art may be outdated.
NOTE 2: Some types are limited with how many frames I will make, however you can always request again at a later point for me to add in more frames for a separate animation. For example: large walk sprites can only have one direction, but you can wait until a slot is open in the future and request another direction then.
KEY:
Key note: Difficulty levels work as an approximate of how long it will take me. For each type and style, add the difficulty amounts together. (EX: High type and high style could take about a week)
(text)
=    Extra Info
[text]
=    Types - Info you should include in request
High
=    This one will be a struggle -
Couple Days (at least)
Medium
=    Medium Difficulty -
A Day (at least)
Low
=    Easy breezy -
Couple Hours (at least)
Unknown
=    Don’t Know Difficulty Level Yet
​
Spoiler:
TYPES
TYPE EXAMPLES
This is a list of the resource types that you can request, with a couple of examples. Resources do have limits on sizes and other aspects. Make sure to read the notes for the resource type you are thinking of requesting for!
Busts
! H
igh Difficulty !
(One character, four expressions max. Pixel busts are limited in size.)
Include info in your request: [Expressions(four max)]
Face Sets
Medium Difficulty
(One character. Eight expressions max. Pixel face sets may be scaled up.
)
Include info in your request: [Expressions(eight max)]
Sprite Sheets
! High Difficulty !
(One character, 64 x 64 per frame max.
Large characters are limited to just one direction.
)
Include info in your request:
[Walk(4 Directions)
OR
Behavior(1 Direction)]
SV Weapons
Medium Difficulty
(One Weapon, three frames.)
Static Battler
Medium Difficulty
(Static, not taking on requests for very large battlers.)
SV Battler
! High Difficulty !
(One three frame animation, 64 x 64 per frame max.)
Balloon Icons
Low Difficulty
(Three balloons max.)
Icons
Low Difficulty
(Five icons max.)
Tilesets
I am NOT taking on tilesets at the moment.
Other
I am open to trying to make different resource types which are not listed here, as I always want to learn to make something new. Feel free to ask and I'll see what I can come up with!
​
Spoiler:
STYLES
STYLE EXAMPLES
This is a list of the styles that I've done before, however I am open to trying other styles.
(I will do my best to copy styles, but there is no guarantee it will work out properly.

IMPORTANT NOTE:
I do struggle with styles that have realistic/blended shading, and/or mechanical parts. I would advise against requesting these as I am much less likely to be able to complete them.

Hey, Smash, I’ve got a ...
REQUEST
But this one is a little odd...
RESOURCE TYPE: Title-border ( /img/Titles2/ ), yes I know it's not in the list, but it's a piece of art that is often lost in the other parts of making a game.
STYLE: Art Deco or Art Nouveau
ENGINE: MV
EXTRA INFO:  Smash, I am throwing this up here because I've noticed that there really aren't that many title-borders (titles2) on RMW.  I realize a little google'ing can come up with some borders, but it would be super sweet to have some here on RMW. My particular desire would be Art Deco or Art Nouveau style, since it would match well with "Steampunk" "Western" or "Modern." However, it's not terribly necessary (I'm working on another project at the moment).  Gold/Brass colored lines with lots of squares and triangles would be fantastic, since it matches some default tiles (pretty sure that's art deco?).
For me it is a future project (I'm more than willing to share the details, I just hadn't got around to making a page yet); however, I believe the community would benefit from more title-borders in general.
Since the request is a little out of bounds, I'll happily accept a  "no." Still, it's a resource type that I've simply not seen many of, and I think it would benefit more than just myself to have a few more available.  I think the image type is usually fairly large, but it's mostly transparent space to overlay on a title screen's background image.
Oh, I gotta say thanks again for the slime -- it really does breathe some life into the character!!

Hey, Smash, I’ve got a...
REQUEST
RESOURCE TYPE - Battlebacks1 battle foreground
STYLE - MV RTP (though at 1296x720 resolution)
ENGINE - RMMV
WHAT IS IT?
A battleback ground layer for an underground dwarven train. I will use an existing cave battleback for the scrolling background image but I need a train platform for fights to take place on.
The fights will be pincer style, so the players will be in the center of the battleback instead of the right hand side.
I would prefer if the fight is taking place at the railcar level with the engine on one side and boxcars on the other, and not on top of the box cars (which are the only battlebacks I've been able to find so far).
References below. DM me if you need any more detail!
Spoiler:
Reference Images
Here's a reference to the proportions needed.
- This is a 1296x720 canvas.
- The empty space will be filled by the battlebacks2 background that will be scrolling to simulate train movement.
- Everything blue and below is generally where the battle foreground is filled. The train doesn't need to obscure absolutely all of this and I can put a cave floor underneath that scrolls in time with the background.
- Green is where the UI obscures some of the scene, so less detail is required here.
- Red horizontal lines are where the feet of the characters are planted. The vertical line shows the height of the upper most character.
